subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Should this PR become the canonical Microsoft Teams sanitizer fix, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 closed after sufficient live proof?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same missing hook, but neither currently satisfies the external-PR real behavior proof gate; current-base quality and proof should determine which contribution is retained.

options.title: Keep this PR as canonical
options.body: Request live Teams or Bot Framework proof here, refresh the branch and checks, then close the older overlapping PR once this branch is ready.

options.body: Ask the older PR to add equivalent delivery-boundary coverage and live proof, then close this branch as superseded.
